title: swe-bench Docker image uses Python 3.5, incompatible with `tree-sitter==0.21.3` required by edit_anthropic
author: Hambaobao

comments.author: klieret
comments.body:
Hi, thanks for the detailed report!

One option to resolve this is to use a different python for the tools. We've started doing this since a while, but it's currently not the default behavior: You can just do a sed replace of all shebangs like [this](https://github.com/SWE-agent/SWE-agent/commit/c79ac2591fb66a84a26858a05d9bb209c2d473aa) and then also [update the installation](https://github.com/SWE-agent/SWE-agent/commit/c79ac2591fb66a84a26858a05d9bb209c2d473aa).

Another hotfix you could do might be to downgrade `tree-sitter` to `0.20.4`, I just checked that this only requires `py>3.3` (but not sure if this version is enough).

However, I also think that the pip install fails shouldn't be enough to cause the agent to quit. `str_replace_editor` is already fault tolerant in that it falls back to normal print if there's a problem with the filemap.

So for a quick fix/workaround, let me just make sure that install failures of treesitter are ignored.
